newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Analysts see Danish Mch CPI up 2.1pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Analysts see Danish Mch CPI up 2.1pct y/y.

text.p: Eleven economists polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Friday forecast an average 2.1 percent year-on-year rise in Danish consumer prices for March, down from February's 2.2 percent.
The estimates ranged from 1.9 percent to 2.3 percent.
The analysts foresaw the rise from February to March at an average 0.4 percent, with estimates in the +0.2-+2.7 percent range. There was no monthly rise in February.
The estimates were based on the domestic calculation method. The national statistics office releases the Danish March CPI data based on both EU and domestic formulas on April 23.
